questions.prompt: After vendor/lib.min.js is marked -diff, what does git diff show when the file changes?
options: A one-line notice that binary files differ, without the content
The full line-by-line diff as before
Nothing at all; the change is ignored by git

goals.label: .gitattributes is committed and gives the five files the right attributes

checks.script: a=$(git check-attr -a -- notes.txt scripts/build.sh assets/logo.png vendor/lib.min.js docs/internal.md) && grep -qxE 'notes.txt: text: (auto|set)' <<<"$a" && grep -qx 'scripts/build.sh: eol: lf' <<<"$a" && grep -qx 'assets/logo.png: text: unset' <<<"$a" && grep -qx 'assets/logo.png: diff: unset' <<<"$a" && grep -qx 'vendor/lib.min.js: diff: unset' <<<"$a" && grep -qx 'docs/internal.md: export-ignore: set' <<<"$a"

goals.label: notes.txt and scripts/build.sh are stored with LF endings
